title: Scanned PDF, three pages, no text layer, Dominican pesos

document.howTo: Run build-documents.ts, print 03-scanned-dop.print.pdf (three pages) and scan it into one PDF with no text layer: the scanner's plain PDF, not a searchable or OCR one, at 200 to 300 dpi and under 4 MB. Save it as eval/quotes/documents/03-scanned-dop.pdf.

pending.change: A8 case 3: the owner must set the rule; A8 proposes battery voltage on battery lines only. The inverter line writes 24 V.

notes: Page 1 is a cover letter, page 2 the items, page 3 the totals and conditions; every line carries page 2.
'Cableado y protecciones' is one wiring line, as A8 lists it. The prompt's bundle rule would allow a second line at 0 for the protections, which shows as an extra line.
'Precios sujetos a cambio ... después de 15 días' writes no date: a validUntil worked out from it is a hallucination.
date is expected as YYYY-MM-DD, as A8 writes it for case 1; today's prompt sets no date format, so a miss there may be the format alone.
